2008: "The company was founded by David Feller and Vadim Geshel in early 2008."
2013: "In March 2013, Yummly opened access to its application programming interface to other companies as a paid service."
2014: "In 2014, Yummly had 15 million active users in the US and launched international websites in the UK, Germany and The Netherlands."
2024: "On 3rd April 2024, website TheSpoon reported that the entire Yummly team had been made redundant."
2024: "The app and website were taken offline in December 2024, with the latter pointing to KitchenAid's US website."
2017: "In May 2017, the company was acquired by appliance maker Whirlpool Corporation and allowed to operate as a subsidiary, keeping its current head office."
